title: Coast Guard finds debris from medical plane carrying 6 people
content: Flight data shows the jet dropped at least 9,000 feet over two minutes, then leveled off for several more minutes, before disappearing.

title: Can the Cornell lawsuit force changes that make students safer?
content: Universities have responsibilities when students report sexual assault, even if prosecutors don't bring charges. Attorney Baine Kerr explains how those protections work.

title: Opinion: A Hawk is not the same as a Hawkeye
content: This was emphasized to people watching a Senate hearing this week, where confusion over two basketball teams was on display.

title: Economist Betsey Stevenson breaks down the gender gap in recent hiring reports
content: The U.S. economy added fewer jobs than expected last month and unemployment ticked up to 4.2%. NPR's Scott Simon talks to Betsey Stevenson, an economist at the University of Michigan.

title: All's fair in love and 'War' — a well-cast, classy-trashy divorce drama
content: HBO's War is intended to be an anthology series about two dueling London law firms. The first season stars Dominic West and Sienna Miller as a high-profile couple in the midst of a very nasty divorce.

title: Just short of its 200th birthday, a landmark natural history museum shuts down
content: Beloved for its dinosaurs, Philadelphia's storied Academy of Natural Sciences closed down this week, amid an intense fight by local residents, politicians and scientists to save it.

title: The Supreme Court faces another term jam-packed with controversy
content: The Supreme Court term opens on Monday with big test cases on religion, guns and climate change. Plus, the emergency docket keeps popping.

title: No one expected Leo to be pope — except everyone who knew him as 'Bob'
content: When the 2025 conclave began, no one expected an American pope. But by its end, Cardinal Robert Prevost had become Pope Leo. Here's a look behind the scenes.

title: 4 ways to battle performance anxiety, according to a confidence coach
content: Worried about stumbling before a high-stakes event, like a race or a job interview? Psychologist Cindra Kamphoff offers creative strategies to overcome the jitters and build confidence in the moment.

title: How the system failed us: Former foster youth tell their stories
content: Former foster youth with disabilities tell their stories — of how they got through foster care
